text: せっかく　きた　のに　ごめんなさい　してんのうの　カンナさんが　いま　おるすで　ポケモンリーグは　しばらく　おやすみ　してるの

structure.jp: せっかく　きた　のに
structure.en: even though you came all this way

structure.jp: してんのうの　カンナさんが　いま　おるすで
structure.en: Lorelei of the Elite Four is away right now, so

structure.jp: ポケモンリーグは　しばらく　おやすみ　してるの
structure.en: the Pokémon League is closed for a while

patterns.name: 〜のに
patterns.explanation: のに means 'even though', with a feeling that the result is a pity. With せっかく it stresses wasted effort. せっかく　きた　のに = 'even though you took the trouble to come'.

patterns.name: 〜で (reason)
patterns.explanation: で here is the linking form of だ and gives the reason for what follows. おるすで = 'is away, so'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: ている says a state is going on now; してる is the shortened spoken form of している. おやすみ　してる = 'is closed at the moment'.
